name: Saf
title: Philistine Giant Killed by David's Hero
summary: Saf (also known as Sippai) was one of the giants from the Philistine city of Gath, a descendant of Rapha (the Rephaites). He was killed by Sibbekai the Hushathite in one of David's wars against the Philistines.

keyEvents.title: Saf Killed by Sibbekai
keyEvents.description: In a war against the Philistines, the giant Saf, one of Rapha's descendants, was killed by Sibbekai the Hushathite. This was one of several battles where David's mighty men defeated the Philistine giants.

keyEvents.title: Sippai Killed at Gob
keyEvents.description: In the parallel account in 1 Chronicles, the giant is called Sippai (another form of the name Saf), and he was killed by Sibbekai the Hushathite, which led to the subjugation of the Philistines.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Giants from Gath
keyEvents.description: Saf was one of several giants from Gath who were killed by David's heroes. These battles demonstrated that David's mighty men continued the tradition established in David's fight against Goliath.

keyEvents.title: The Downfall of the Philistines
keyEvents.description: The killing of Saph and the other giants from Gath marked a significant phase in David's military superiority over the Philistines and secured Israel's borders.
